title: From bytes to source
subtitle: Five intermediate representations used by recovery passes

rungs.label: Raw
rungs.detail: Identify the format; extract or unpack its contents.

rungs.label: Disasm
rungs.detail: Decode operations while retaining their offsets.

rungs.label: MIR
